<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Hiring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hiring and Onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_HiringNeed" name="Need for a new hire identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJobBoards" name="Post job on job boards"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectForInterview" name="Selected for further interview?" default="Flow_NotSelected"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotSelected" name="Candidate not selected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteInterview" name="Invite candidate to interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewPreference" name="Interview preference?" default="Flow_VirtualInterview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeInterviews" name="Merge interview paths"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CandidateChosen" name="Candidate chosen?" default="Flow_NotChosen"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotChosen" name="Candidate not chosen"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation" name="Salary negotiation needed?" default="Flow_NoNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SalaryNegotiation" name="Negotiate salary"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeNegotiation" name="Merge negotiation paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete onboarding paperwork"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Orientation" name="Complete orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Complete training"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="New hire fully integrated into the team"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_HiringNeed" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobBoards"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_PostJobBoards" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_SelectForInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectedForInterview" name="Selected" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectForInterview" targetRef="Task_InviteInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidate.selectedForInterview = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSelected" name="Not selected" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectForInterview" targetRef="EndEvent_NotSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_InviteInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InPersonInterview" name="In-person" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidate.interviewPreference = 'in-person'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VirtualInterview" name="Virtual" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_MergeInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_MergeInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chosen" name="Chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidate.chosen = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotChosen" name="Not chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen" targetRef="EndEvent_NotChosen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiationNeeded" name="Negotiation needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation" targetRef="Task_SalaryNegotiation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">salaryNegotiationNeeded = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoNegotiation" name="No negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation" targetRef="Gateway_MergeNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_SalaryNegotiation" targetRef="Gateway_MergeNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeNegotiation" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_Orientation" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
